name: Donkey Kong's Revenge
source:
This is a visual novel where you play as Donkey Kong and try and plan a murder and get away with it.

[From [url=https://www.glorioustrainwrecks.com/node/10944]Glorious Trainwrecks[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，你将扮演咚奇刚，试着策划一场谋杀，并逃脱罪责。

[摘自[url=https://www.glorioustrainwrecks.com/node/10944]Glorious Trainwrecks[/url]]
